Armadillo.headline: Three teams at 2-0, three at 0-2, and Burrow my Cook in Nabors keeps getting cooked
paragraphs: xovsa0989 beat kbartelt07 147.08 to 133.18 with Brock Purdy (28.48), Jaylen Waddle (21.8) and the Vikings defense (18.0). After Waddle's 1.2 in week 1, the namesake finally showed up for Waddlin to london. The other namesake, Drake London, scored 8.9. One out of two.

kbartelt07 left 23.3 points on the bench, Jake Ferguson's 20.3 among them, and lost by 13.9. The right lineup wins this one. The team is called Burrow my Cook in Nabors, and this week James Cook scored 20.9 and Malik Nabers scored 1.1. kbartelt07 is 0-2.
Burrow my Cook in Nabors: half the Cook, none of the Nabors, all of the losses.

YukonMike moved to 2-0, beating Rowdy0991 169.32 to 127.28. Josh Allen scored 39.82, CeeDee Lamb 35.3 and Travis Kelce 25.1. DJ Moore managed -0.1 in the lineup while Stefon Diggs scored 21.7 on the bench, and YukonMike left 31.0 unused. When you can leave 31 points on the pine and still win by 42, you are not coaching, you are just rich.

Rowdy0991 left 33.5 on the bench, the most in the conference. Matthew Stafford scored 27.98 there while Jared Goff started and scored 27.78, which is a 0.2-point mistake and does not count. Dalton Kincaid scoring 22.5 on the bench while Dallas Goedert started for 1.4 absolutely counts.
Rowdy0991 benched 33.5 points and the tight end got Goedert'd.
queens22 moved to 2-0 with a 142.66 to 125.08 win over Juravieal. Dak Prescott scored 29.76, and Christian McCaffrey and Chris Olave both scored 22.6.

The Phyrexian Dreadnoughts got 26.0 from Dalton Schultz and 23.3 from Jahmyr Gibbs, and then Ladd McConkey (6.5) and Jameson Williams (5.3) showed up like guys who RSVP'd and left after one drink. Bo Nix scored 15.12 on the bench. Juravieal left 8.2 unused and lost by 17.58. No excuses here, just a worse team on the day.
queens22 2-0, Juravieal 1-1. No further questions.
Argrider moved to 2-0 by beating Thomasg2488 145.36 to 124.88, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 42.5 was the best individual score in the conference. My Tush Hurts left 12.1 on the bench and did not care.

Thomasg2488 did a lot right: Amon-Ra St. Brown went for 35.2 and Patrick Mahomes, back off the bench, scored 28.98. Tucker Kraft scored 2.5 and the Ravens defense 3.0, and that was enough to lose by 20.48. Thomasg2488 is 0-2.
Thomasg2488 started Mahomes this time. Still 0-2. Sometimes the universe just has it out for you.

lowkeyeastt beat cartercole 135.00 to 110.42, and Wide Receivers' Galore finally got a wide receiver to show up: Davante Adams scored 39.5. Jonathan Taylor added 29.2. Courtland Sutton (5.5) and Colston Loveland (1.3) started again and disappointed again, but this time it did not matter.

cartercole is 0-2 after scoring 110.42, the lowest in the Armadillo this week. Ja'Marr Chase put up 26.5, Rhamondre Stevenson put up 2.6, and TreVeyon Henderson put up 13.6 on the bench. Tate Dogg and Warren T, it is time to regulate.
One Davante Adams is apparently all the galore lowkeyeastt needed.

Grizzly.headline: adamgum wins by 104 and kingruddofrock might want to look away
paragraphs: adamgum beat kingruddofrock 192.28 to 88.22, a 104.06-point beating, the biggest margin in APFN this week and the kind that gets talked about at the draft next year. Davante Adams scored 39.5, Amon-Ra St. Brown 35.2 and Brock Purdy 28.48. adamgum is 2-0.

kingruddofrock scored 88.22, the second-lowest in the Grizzly, with Christian McCaffrey's 22.6 leading the way. Bryce Young scored 24.08 on the bench. Baker Mayfield scored 13.18 on the bench. Maye I See Dem TD's has a quarterback problem, and the problem is choosing one. kingruddofrock is 0-2.
Maye I See Dem TD's? Bryce Young saw 24.08 of them. From the bench.
ArmedRodgery21 beat Dfiasco0 164.76 to 102.90 and is 2-0. Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 42.5 and Dak Prescott 29.76, and ArmedRodgery21 still had Jared Goff's 27.78 on the bench as a spare.

Little Giants got 23.3 from Jahmyr Gibbs and 18.0 from the Vikings defense. Then Jaxson Dart, who went for 25.6 in week 1, scored 0.8. Rhamondre Stevenson scored 2.6. Dfiasco0 left 16.1 on the bench and lost by 61.86, so this was not a lineup problem. This was a getting-your-ass-kicked problem.
Little Giants, small Sunday.

vpettijohnjr beat Ghaztyz 131.18 to 68.10, behind Ja'Marr Chase (26.5), Travis Kelce (25.1) and Jaylen Waddle (21.8). Fresh off leaving 57.7 on the bench in week 1, Medicaid's Most Wanted left 11.5 this time and won by 63.08. Growth.

Ghaztyz scored 68.10, the lowest score in either conference this week, and is 0-2. The two namesakes of Kraftin' Lamars combined for 18.3: Lamar Jackson 15.8, Tucker Kraft 2.5. The best player on the team scored 15.8. Josh Downs (14.2) and Jayden Daniels (13.74) sat on the bench, which would have helped exactly nobody close a 63-point gap.
Kraftin' Lamars is less a fantasy team and more an arts and crafts disaster.

thatguyPegleg moved to 2-0 by beating seachicken22 129.72 to 118.26, with DeVonta Smith (27.7) and James Cook (20.9). The Nabers Cook Dope got 20.9 from the Cook and 1.1 from the Nabers. Half a team name is still a win.

seachicken22 got 29.2 from Jonathan Taylor and 23.8 from Kenneth Walker, then started Colston Loveland for 1.3 while Jake Ferguson scored 20.3 on the bench. seachicken22 left 19.0 unused and lost by 11.46. The right lineup wins.
seachicken22 had the winning lineup. Just not on the field.

chookonthecoast got off the mark, beating IronMike1987 151.12 to 139.28 with Josh Allen's 39.82, the New England defense (23.0) and George Kittle (18.0). Patrick Mahomes scored 28.98 on the bench, so even Certified Coke Head's backup quarterback put up a number most teams would happily start.

IronMike1987 is 0-2, and this one hurt. CeeDee Lamb scored 35.3. Joe Burrow started and scored 16.18 while Matthew Stafford scored 27.98 on the bench. IronMike1987 left 18.6 points unused and lost by 11.84. The right lineup wins.
IronMike1987 lost a game the bench would have won. Iron will, wooden decisions.

Robber.headline: Amon-Ra gets stolen twice and Juravieal gets mugged again
paragraphs: ArmedRodgery21 beat cartercole 165.02 to 139.36 and is 2-0. Josh Allen scored 40.82, Jonathan Taylor 29.2, and Jahmyr Gibbs, stolen last week, scored 23.3 for a new owner. Then the funny part. Amon-Ra St. Brown scored 35.2 for cartercole in this loss, a week after cartercole stole him from Ghaztyz. So ArmedRodgery21 stole him again.
Amon-Ra St. Brown has had three teams in two weeks. Even Jeantyfied Naberhood couldn't hold onto the stolen goods.

adamgum beat Juravieal 126.08 to 67.32, and the Collectible Cardigans' 67.32 was the lowest score in APFN this week. Tee Higgins led them with 14.5. Mike Gesicki scored 0.0, Brock Bowers scored 0.0 on the bench, and nobody scored more than 14.5. Then Reaper25 stole D'Andre Swift. After losing Bijan Robinson in week 1, Juravieal is 0-2 and getting stripped for parts.
Collectible Cardigans? At this point it's a clearance rack.

queens22 is 2-0 after beating vpettijohnjr 127.92 to 86.48, mostly on Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 42.5. Pukkake is 0-2, robbed for a second straight week, and this time queens22 took Puka Nacua, who scored 0.0 sitting on the Pukkake bench.
Pukkake got robbed again. It is becoming a whole genre.

Ghaztyz bounced back from week 1, beating thatguyPegleg 168.08 to 122.90 with Davante Adams (39.5), Brock Purdy (28.48) and DeVonta Smith (27.7). LaPorta potty then took Ja'Marr Chase, who scored 26.5 for thatguyPegleg in the loss.
LaPorta potty went from getting flushed to doing the flushing.

kbartelt07 beat Dfiasco0 139.50 to 107.14 for a first win, with James Cook and George Kittle scoring 20.9 and 18.0. Christian McCaffrey scored 22.6 for Hide Your Players in the loss, so Rashee's Lambo took Christian McCaffrey.
Hide Your Players didn't. Rashee's Lambo now has a McCaffrey in the trunk.
